name: Waveland
goal: Air dodge into the stage or a platform as you land
why: A waveland ends a fall early with a slide: {char} lands out of the air dodge with 10 frames of landing lag and slides with its speed along the floor. On platforms it is how {char} lands on them and moves across them, and the slide sets where {char} stands when the landing lag ends.

tutorial.what: A waveland is an air dodge into the floor just before {char} would land: the stage or a platform. {char} lands out of the air dodge and slides.
tutorial.expect: Each waveland is judged when {char} lands: whether the air dodge touched the floor, and how many frames after L or R it did. After misses, the coach shows your presses frame by frame.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed and released. Short hop
marks.SA: Frame {SA}: the top of the short hop
marks.SL-1: Frame {SL-1}: just above the floor. R pressed, stick down and forward
marks.SL+2: Landed out of the air dodge: landing lag, sliding

lessons.title: An air dodge that touches a floor
text: An air dodge that touches a floor ends there: {char} lands in 10 frames of landing lag and slides with the air dodge's speed along the floor. Platforms are floors too. On the first frame in the air after a jump it is a wavedash; later in a jump or a fall it is a waveland.

The air dodge moves in the direction of the control stick and loses a tenth of its speed every frame. Pressed in the last 3 frames before {char} would land, frames {SL-2} to {SL} of a short hop, it touches down within 3 frames with nearly all of it.

marks.SL-1: Frame {SL-1}: R pressed, just above the floor

cues.words: Press L or R now: the last 3 frames of the fall

lessons.title: Too high, too flat
text: Pressed near the top of the jump, the air dodge has a long way down. It slows as it goes, touches down later than {char} would have landed, and the slide is short.

From the air, aim further down than for a wavedash. A stick close to horizontal skims above the floor: pressed 2 frames before landing with the stick 17 degrees down, Fox touches down 19 frames later; at 45 or 60 degrees, 2 frames later.

marks.SA: Frame {SA}: R pressed at the top: too high
marks.SA+1: Frame {f}: the air dodge slows on the way down

cues.words: Pressed at the top: too high
The air dodge slows on the way down

verdict.success: Waveland. Frames from L or R to touchdown: {to_land}.

into the floor.expect: An air dodge that touches the floor
into the floor.words: landed out of a fall, not out of an air dodge
into the floor.headline: No air dodge into the floor
into the floor.fix: Press L or R with the stick down and forward while {char} comes down, close enough above the floor that the air dodge reaches it.

as you land.expect: Touch down within 3 frames of L or R
as you land.words: touched down {frames} after L or R
as you land.headline: Early air dodge
as you land.fix: Press L or R in the last 3 frames before {char} would land: frames {SL-2} to {SL} of a short hop. The air dodge loses a tenth of its speed every frame before it touches down: pressed high, it lands later and slides less.

parts.name: Air dodge into the floor
parts.teach: Short hop, then press R with the stick down and forward. The air dodge carries {char} down to the stage: {char} lands out of it in 10 frames of landing lag and slides.

marks.SA: Frame {SA}: R pressed at the top, stick down and forward

parts.success: Air dodge into the floor: {char} slides.

coach.note: Press L or R while {char} is in the air, with the stick down and forward.

parts.name: As you land
parts.teach: On the platform: short hop, and press R in the last 3 frames of the fall, frames {SL-2} to {SL}, just above the platform. The air dodge touches down within 3 frames and {char} slides. The stage counts the same.

marks.SL-1: Frame {SL-1}: R pressed just above the platform

cues.words: Press L or R now: the last 3 frames of the fall

coach.note: {char}'s short hop lands on frame {SL}: press L or R on a frame from {SL-2} to {SL}.
